Slayer.name: 猎杀者 Slayer
Slayer.text:
世界充满了危险而强大的存在，但猎杀者知道没有不可战胜的威胁。你可能是一个追求更稀有猎物的猎手，一个守护弱者的勇士，或者是一个执着追猎宿敌的复仇者；无论动机为何，几乎无人能在追猎单一强敌方面胜过你。凭借专门打造的军械、过往狩猎所得的战利品，以及你不屈的意志，你总是比上一次更为充分地准备迎接新的猎物。

关键属性：力量或敏捷

1级时，由你选择，你的职业在力量或敏捷上给与你属性提升。

生命值 10 加上你的体质调整值

在1级以及之后的每一级，你的最大生命值都会增加这个数值。

在战斗遭遇中……

你会因盟友的成功或敌人的倒下而愈发振奋，以一连串追猎技艺不断压制对手。你利用怪物学识识别敌人的弱点，并用量身打造的狩猎工具加以利用这些弱点。

在社交遭遇中……

你会提供来自训练与经验，尤其是在危险生物方面的见解。你的敏锐观察与坚强意志使你难以被欺骗或分心。

在探索中……

你收集信息以选择你的下一个猎物，并准备工具针对其弱点；你以先前狩猎得来的战利品强化军械库。你以敏锐的感官协助队伍追踪或警戒危险。

在休整期中……

你会侧耳倾听关于未来猎物的传闻。你也可能为自己与同伴打造武器护甲，或通过狩猎小型猎物来保持手感。

你也许……

  • 偏爱亲手改装的武器与护甲，而非购买现成装备。
  • 遇到新生物时迅速记录笔记或采集样本。
  • 面对猎物时变得更加凶猛，甚至让同伴侧目。

其他人可能……

  • 依靠你来识别神秘的足迹或流言。
  • 认为你每天早上的精心准备过于谨慎。
  • 被你佩戴的战利品收藏所威慑。

职业特性

作为一名猎杀者，你获得以下能力。在更高等级获得的能力会在特性名称旁边列出你获得它们的等级。

族裔与背景

除了你在1级时从职业获得的能力外，你还会获得你所选族裔和背景的增益。

属性提升

除了你在1级时从职业获得的属性提升外，你还会获得四项自由属性提升，分配到不同的属性调整值上。

在5级以及之后的每5级，你会获得四项自由属性提升，分配到不同的属性调整值上。如果一项属性调整值已经达到+4或更高，则需要两次提升才能使其增加；你会获得部分提升，并且必须在之后的等级再次提升该属性才能使其增加1点。

The world is full of dangerous and mighty beings, but slayers know that no threat is unbeatable. You could be a trapper in pursuit of rarer game, a brave defender of the weak, or a dogged pursuer of a hated nemesis; whatever your reasons, few are more skilled than you at hunting singular and deadly foes. Equipped with an arsenal of specialized tools, the spoils of your previous hunts, and your indomitable spirit, you are always more prepared for each new quarry than the last.

Key Attribute: STRENGTH OR DEXTERITY

At 1st level, your class gives you an attribute boost to your choice of Strength or Dexterity.

Hit Points 10 plus your Constitution modifier

You increase your maximum number of HP by this number at 1st level and every level thereafter.

During combat encounters...

You are emboldened by your allies' successes or by defeated foes, following up with a relentless series of techniques. You use your knowledge of monsters to identify your enemies' weaknesses and your arsenal of customized hunting tools to exploit them.

During social encounters...

You offer insights gleaned from training and experience, especially on the subject of dangerous creatures. Your perceptiveness and strong will make you difficult to deceive or distract.

While exploring...

You gather information to choose your next quarry and prepare your tools to target its vulnerabilities. You reinforce your arsenal with trophies claimed from previous hunts. You use your keen senses to help your group with tracking or watch for trouble.

In downtime...

You keep your ear to the ground for rumors about future quarry. You might also craft weapons and armor for yourself and your group, or spend your time hunting small game to keep your skills sharp.

You might...

  • Have a preference for weapons and armor you customize yourself, eschewing store-bought gear.
  • Swiftly take notes or samples when you encounter a new creature.
  • Grow more ferocious when faced with your quarry, startling your allies.

Others probably...

  • Rely on you to identify mysterious tracks or rumors.
  • Believe your careful preparations each morning are overly cautious.
  • Are intimidated by the collection of trophies you wear.

Class Features

You gain these abilities as a slayer. Abilities gained at higher levels list the level at which you gain them next to the features' names.

Ancestry and Background

In addition to what you get from your class at 1st level, you have the benefits of your selected ancestry and background.

Attribute Boosts

In addition to what you get from your class at 1st level, you have four free boosts to different attribute modifiers.

At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, you get four free boosts to different attribute modifiers. If an attribute modifier is already +4 or higher, it takes two boosts to increase it; you get a partial boost, and must boost that attribute again at a later level to increase it by 1.

Initial Proficiencies

At 1st level, you gain a number of proficiencies that represent your basic training. These proficiencies are noted at the start of this class.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, you gain a skill increase. You can use this increase to either become trained in one skill you're untrained in, or become an expert in one skill in which you're already trained.

Daredevil.name: 狂徒 Daredevil
Daredevil.text:
你冲入他人畏缩不前之处，对任何危险都毫不在意。你在背水一战、以寡敌众的时刻中茁壮成长。你冲过战场，看似要迎向敌人，却用一个惊人的险招让他们措手不及、踉跄后退。整个过程，肾上腺素在你体内奔涌，助燃着你对风险的热爱。

关键属性：力量或敏捷

1级时，你的职业赋予你一次属性提升，可选择力量或敏捷。

生命值 8 加上你的体质调整值

你在1级和之后每个等级将你的最大生命值提升该数值。

在战斗遭遇中……

你总是处于移动之中，因为仅仅是战斗还不足以让你肾上腺素持续沸腾。你蹬墙借力、绕柱旋身，甚至在更庞大的敌人之间来回弹跃，全然不顾惹怒那些更擅长借机出手的对手的风险。你的打击可能不如其他战斗职业那么沉重，但你的后续攻击通常更为可靠，因此命中率更高。

在社交遭遇中……

你可能热情外向，把最新一次冒险留下的擦伤淤青当笑谈；也可能阴郁孤僻，更愿意在肾上腺素退去后独自休养。无论如何，你那些因险招留下的疤痕，总能成为有趣的谈资。

在探索中……

地城、破败神殿与其他冒险地点的险境就是你的家常便饭，因此你常在此类场合带头引路。你并不总是故意去触发致命陷阱，但你确实能迅速从这类危局中脱身。

在休整期中……

多亏你承受打击的本事，你一般比大多数人花更少时间休养。闲暇时，你也许会靠为观众表演那些以命相搏的绝活来赚取钱财。

你也许……

  • 面对危险时放声大笑。
  • 经常让自己陷入困境。
  • 喜欢炫耀你收集的伤疤和愈合的断骨。

其他人可能……

  • 担心你冒太大的风险。
  • 被你无所畏惧的态度所激励。
  • 兴奋地跟随你进入危险和冒险之中。

初始熟练

1级时，你在下列统计数据上获得列出的熟练等级。除非你通过其他方式获得更好的熟练等级，否则你在未列出的项目上视为未受训。

You rush headlong where others fear to tread, heedless of any dangers. You thrive in those moments where your back is up against the wall and the odds are against you. You dash across the battlefield seemingly to face an enemy only to catch them by surprise with an astounding stunt that sends them reeling. All the while, adrenaline courses through your body, fueling your appetite for risk.

Key Attribute: STRENGTH OR DEXTERITY

At 1st level, your class gives you an attribute boost to your choice of Strength or Dexterity.

Hit Points 8 plus your Constitution modifier

You increase your maximum number of HP by this number at 1st level and every level thereafter.

During combat encounters...

You are constantly on the move, as the act of merely fighting isn't enough to keep your adrenaline pumping. You push yourself off walls, spin around pillars, and even ricochet between larger foes all while risking the ire of more reactive combatants. You may not hit as hard as other martial characters, but your follow-up attacks are often more reliable so you tend to hit more often.

During social encounters...

You might be a gregarious individual, laughing off your cuts and bruises from your latest escapade. Or you might be a brooding loner, preferring to be left alone to recuperate once the adrenaline has worn off. In either case, the scars from your stunts can make for interesting conversation pieces.

While exploring...

The dangers of dungeons, ruined temples, and other sites of adventure are your bread and butter, so you often lead your allies in these situations. While you try not to trigger deadly traps on purpose, you can quickly extricate yourself from such hazards.

In downtime...

Thanks to your ability to withstand punishment, you generally spend less time recuperating than most. In your spare time, you might earn coin by performing your death-defying acts for an audience.

You might...

  • Laugh in the face of danger.
  • Regularly get yourself in over your head.
  • Enjoy showing off your collection of scars and mended broken bones.

Others probably...

  • Worry that you take too many risks.
  • Get inspired by your devil-may-care attitude.
  • Follow you excitedly into peril and adventure.

Class Features

You gain these abilities as a daredevil. Abilities gained at higher levels list the level at which you gain them next to the features' names.

Ancestry and Background

In addition to what you get from your class at 1st level, you have the benefits of your selected ancestry and background.

Attribute Boosts

In addition to what you get from your class at 1st level, you have four free boosts to different attribute modifiers.

At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, you get four free boosts to different attribute modifiers. If an attribute modifier is already +4 or higher, it takes two boosts to increase it; you get a partial boost, and must boost that attribute again at a later level to increase it by 1.
